graph_app.label: Microsoft Graph application permissions
graph_app.unlock: Grant and consent the collector's Microsoft Graph application permissions (rerun setup-service-principal.ps1).

defender_app.label: Defender for Endpoint API application permission
defender_app.unlock: Grant and consent Machine.Read.All on the WindowsDefenderATP API (rerun setup).

power_platform_app.label: Power Platform API with tenant-scoped Power Platform Reader
power_platform_app.unlock: Assign Power Platform Reader to the application at tenant scope.

graph_sharepoint_settings.label: Microsoft Graph SharePoint tenant settings
graph_sharepoint_settings.unlock: Grant and consent Microsoft Graph application permission SharePointTenantSettings.Read.All (rerun setup). Default link type, anonymous link expiry and per-site settings additionally need SharePoint administration.

graph_sensitivity_labels.label: Microsoft Graph sensitivity labels (beta)
graph_sensitivity_labels.unlock: Grant and consent Microsoft Graph application permission InformationProtectionPolicy.Read.All (rerun setup). Label policies, DLP and retention need Purview PowerShell.

graph_report_settings.label: Microsoft Graph report settings
graph_report_settings.unlock: Grant and consent Microsoft Graph application permission ReportSettings.Read.All (rerun setup).

graph_audit_query.label: Microsoft Graph saved audit query
graph_audit_query.unlock: Opt in with --preview-collectors copilot-audit and grant AuditLogsQuery.Read.All (setup -PreviewCollectors CopilotAudit).

spo_admin_certificate.label: SharePoint admin PowerShell with application certificate
spo_admin_certificate.unlock: Run setup-service-principal.ps1 -EnableSharePointAppOnly (creates a certificate and requests Sites.FullControl.All after explicit approval).

spo_admin_delegated.label: SharePoint admin PowerShell with administrator sign-in
spo_admin_delegated.unlock: Allow the browser sign-in (--interactive-auth auto) as a SharePoint Administrator.

purview_ps_token.label: Purview and Exchange PowerShell with application token
purview_ps_token.unlock: Consent Exchange.ManageAsApp and assign the default read-only role: setup-service-principal.ps1 -WorkloadRbac GlobalReader. Requires ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.8.0 or later.

purview_ps_certificate.label: Purview and Exchange PowerShell with application certificate
purview_ps_certificate.unlock: Configure PURVIEW_CERTIFICATE_THUMBPRINT (setup -EnableSharePointAppOnly or -Mode Unattended) and assign workload roles.

purview_ps_delegated.label: Purview and Exchange PowerShell with administrator sign-in
purview_ps_delegated.unlock: Allow the browser sign-in (--interactive-auth auto) with an account that holds Purview read roles.

graph_delegated.label: Microsoft Graph with administrator sign-in
graph_delegated.unlock: Run with --delegated auto (or required) and sign in as at least a Global Reader. Setup adds the delegated scope and public-client redirect.

legacy_pp_delegated.label: Power Platform admin APIs with device sign-in
legacy_pp_delegated.unlock: Use --legacy-power-platform-collector and sign in as a Power Platform administrator.

restricted.exclusion_reason: Not requested by the Restricted permission profile; use supported customer exports or saved evidence where available.
